title: Father Bob French and uncles Morris and Johnny
summary: French names his father Bob 'Bab' French, a bass tuba player with Kid Rena, his uncles Morris and Johnny, and says his father died in 1925.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And your family, I know your uncle, your uncle Morris French is up?
Up in Laplace. I thought maybe you all came from up that direction.

No, my daddy came from Laplace and my uncle. My dad also played music too. Could you tell us about your father? My father, his name is Bob French, but they call him Bab. Some people call him Bab French. And he played with Kid René. What instrument did he play? He played bass tuba.
Bass tuba. He played with a lot of the bands around here.
I'd heard that one member of the family, I didn't know it was your father who it was.
That's my father and I have an uncle in the Baton Rouge, Johnny French. He's a trumpet player.
Is your father by any chance?
